title: VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland
content:
VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland is a state-owned, non-profit research organization headquartered in Espoo and one of the leading applied research institutes in northern Europe.

Its materials teams develop bio-based porous materials, including nanocellulose foams and aerogels and hybrid cellulose-silica systems for thermal insulation and phase-change energy management, supported by pilot infrastructure such as the Bioruukki pilot centre in Espoo.

VTT partners with companies on aerogel and foam material development, process scale-up and characterization, targeting sustainable insulation, packaging and energy applications.
excerpt: Finnish state research centre developing bio-based nanocellulose aerogels, foams and hybrid insulation materials with pilot-scale infrastructure.
